Class UriRouteTemplate

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.http.uri.UriRouteTemplate
All Implemented Interfaces:
RouteTemplate
public final class UriRouteTemplate extends Object implements RouteTemplate
A route template of the URI template language of Micronaut, e.g. /pets/{id}: the template of the String templates of the route APIs and of the route annotations. It is a UriMatchTemplate, matched with a UriTemplateMatcher; the router matches its routes with the matcher directly.

A URI template captures one value per variable name: every occurrence of a repeated name, e.g. /x/{id}/{id}, has the value the matcher captured for the name, the value of the last occurrence.

Since:
5.3.0
Author:
Denis Stepanov

    • expression

      public String expression()
      Description copied from interface: RouteTemplate
      The expression of the template in its language, e.g. for the routes endpoint, the metrics and BasicHttpAttributes.getUriTemplate(HttpRequest). It is for display: it is not parsed again. Templates are equal when they match the same paths with the same variables: implementations define Object.equals(Object) and Object.hashCode(), e.g. on the expression; the router uses them to find the GET routes that have an explicit HEAD route.
      Specified by:

    • match

      public @Nullable RouteCaptures match(String rawPath)
      Description copied from interface: RouteTemplate
      Match a path. The input is the raw, not percent-decoded path of a request, without its query, which may have a trailing slash. The template applies the rules of its language, e.g. ignores the matrix parameters of the segments, and matches the complete path. The router calls it for every request the route is a candidate for: an implementation prepares its matcher when it is created, and returns RouteCaptures.of(String, List, List) with its RouteTemplate.variables().
      Specified by:
      match in interface RouteTemplate
      Parameters:
      rawPath - The path of the request
      Returns:
      The captures of the variables, not percent-decoded, in the order of RouteTemplate.variables(), or null if the path does not match. A language that captures one value per name gives that value to every occurrence of the name

    • mount

      public RouteTemplate mount(String prefix)
      Description copied from interface: RouteTemplate
      Mount this template under a literal path, e.g. the context path of the server or the prefix of a route group. The prefix is literal text, not an expression of the language. The router mounts a declared template once, and an implementation should reuse what it already prepared rather than parse its expression again.
      Specified by:
      mount in interface RouteTemplate
      Parameters:
      prefix - The literal prefix, starting with a slash and not ending with one
      Returns:
      The mounted template
      Throws:
      UnsupportedOperationException - for a template of a subclass of UriMatchTemplate: mounted, it would lose the rules of its class

    • requiredPrefix

      public String requiredPrefix()
      Description copied from interface: RouteTemplate
      A literal every path the template matches starts with: the raw path without its query and without a trailing slash, the path the route index looks up. It is a necessary condition only: the router uses it to skip the templates that cannot match a path, and does not rely on a trailing slash of the prefix. A template without a prefix is a candidate for every request of its method, and is matched for each of them: give the longest prefix the language allows.
      Specified by:
      requiredPrefix in interface RouteTemplate
      Returns:
      The prefix, starting with a slash, or an empty string when unknown

      public int patternVariableCount()
      Description copied from interface: RouteTemplate
